statement_english: Over Rs 1,003 crore in 76 projects was inaugurated or started in Bijnor and Chandpur seats.
basis: CM inaugurated and laid foundation stones for 76 projects worth over Rs 1,003 crore in the Bijnor and Chandpur assembly constituencies (upcmnews, 18 July 2026). Barhapur is not named in the source (district-level).

statement_hindi: चीनी मिलों में 20 अक्टूबर के आसपास पेराई शुरू होने की उम्मीद है।
statement_english: Sugar mill crushing is expected to start around 20 October, subject to weather.
basis: Crushing 'likely to begin around October 20, subject to weather conditions' (western UP, district-level). Bijnor is named in the report's district list. This is an expectation, not a completed event.

statement_hindi: मंडावर नगर पंचायत में नई पेयजल योजना का लोकार्पण हुआ।
statement_english: A new drinking water scheme was inaugurated in Mandawar nagar panchayat.
basis: CM inaugurated the Mandawar Nagar Panchayat reconstitution drinking water scheme under AMRUT 2.0 (upcmnews, 18 July 2026). Mandawar is not among the AC 19 units named on Wikipedia, so this is district-level, not AC 19.

statement_hindi: बारिश में अफजलगढ़ बिजलीघर टपकता है, बिजली घंटों गुल रहती है।
statement_english: Rain floods the Afzalgarh power station control room, and power is cut for hours.
basis: Afzalgarh power station control-room roof leaks in rain and water halts supply. On 12 July 2026 supply was cut from about midnight to 4 pm, with only 1-2 hours of power in that period (AC-specific: Afzalgarh is in AC 19 per Wikipedia).

statement_hindi: बिलाई मिल पर किसानों का 41 करोड़ से ज्यादा गन्ना बकाया है।
statement_english: Cane farmers are still owed over Rs 41 crore by Bilai sugar mill.
basis: Bilai Sugar Mill owes farmers Rs 41.98 crore, per District Sugarcane Officer Brajesh Kumar Patel; farmer organisations protested and demanded immediate payment. The mill's town is not stated (district-level, Bijnor).

statement_hindi: अफजलगढ़ सीएचसी में पानी भरा, मरीजों को दवा नहीं मिली।
statement_english: Water floods Afzalgarh CHC, medicines are ruined and patients go without.
basis: Afzalgarh CHC flooded 2-3 feet deep after rain; medicine store and records damaged. A patient said patients could not get medicines because of the water (Amar Ujala, Afzalgarh dateline, 7 Sept 2026). AC-specific.

statement_hindi: अफजलगढ़ में अमला पुल की सड़क धंसी, 25 गांवों का संपर्क टूटा।
statement_english: The Amla river bridge road at Afzalgarh sank, cutting off 25 villages.
basis: Soil under the approach road of the old Amla river bridge in Afzalgarh slid; all vehicles were halted; 25+ villages and several Kadrabad-area colonies were cut off. No repair timeline given (Amar Ujala, 29 May 2026). No later update found. AC-specific.

statement_hindi: इस बरसात में चौथी बार सड़कों पर बाढ़ का पानी लौटा।
statement_english: Floodwater came back onto village roads and state highway for the fourth time this monsoon.
basis: Water flowing again on the state highway (Bahsuma-Thakurdwara) and flood-affected area roads; the report says it is the fourth time this monsoon. Datelined Jaleelpur; Jaleelpur's AC is not confirmed as AC 19 (district-level).

statement_hindi: यहां काफी काम हुआ है, कुछ बदलाव साफ दिखते हैं।
statement_english: A lot of work has been done here, and some changes are visible.
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said a lot of work has been done; voter Pritkumar Chauhan said some things have changed (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: विधायक और चेयरमैन ने जहां उम्मीद थी, वहां काम किया है।
statement_english: The MLA and the chairman have done work where it was expected.
basis: Voter Shahreen praised the MLA and the chairman for work done where it was expected (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: कॉलेज में खेल सुविधाएं अच्छी हैं, टीचर बच्चों को अच्छे से प्रेरित करते हैं।
statement_english: The college has good sports facilities and teachers motivate students.
basis: Voter Matiha Zaidi praised the teachers' motivation and the college's sports facilities (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: प्रदेश सरकार से यहां कोई बड़ी परेशानी नहीं है।
statement_english: There is no major trouble with the state government here.
basis: Dr. N.P. Singh said there was no trouble with the state government (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view, not a survey.

statement_hindi: अगला चुनाव मुख्यमंत्री योगी के चेहरे पर ही लड़ा जाएगा।
statement_english: Our next election will be fought on the face of CM Yogi.
basis: Voter Narendra Kumar Rajput praised CM Yogi Adityanath and said the next election would be fought on his face (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view.

statement_hindi: काफी काम हुआ, पर यहां पानी की समस्या आज भी बनी हुई है।
statement_english: There is still a water problem here despite the work done.
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said there is a water problem even though a lot of work has been done (Dhampur town reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: चीनी मिल समय पर भुगतान नहीं करेगी तो हम उसे गन्ना नहीं देंगे।
statement_english: Sugarcane payments are late, so we will not give cane to mills that don't pay.
basis: District-level, not Dhampur-specific: Amar Ujala (Bijnor, 4 Oct 2026) reports BKU (Arajneeti)'s 'no payment, no cane' campaign against the Bilai sugar mill in Bijnor district, and a demand to reallocate its cane area to mills that pay on time. The dues amount is not stated in that article.

statement_hindi: बरसात में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, आवागमन में दिक्कत होती है।
statement_english: Roads get waterlogged in the monsoon and transport gets disrupted.
basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said roads were waterlogged in the last two monsoons, causing transport trouble (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: जल निगम की टंकी जर्जर है, किसी गांव में टंकी पूरी नहीं हुई है।
statement_english: The Jal Nigam water tank is broken down and no village tank is complete.
basis: Voter Chaudhary Kaviraj said a Jal Nigam water tank is dilapidated and no tank in any village has been completed so far (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

statement_hindi: खाद की किल्लत है, किसान परेशान हैं।
statement_english: There is a shortage of fertiliser and farmers are struggling.
basis: Voter Mahendra Pal Singh raised a shortage of fertiliser (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view.
